description: The seven-colour Geneva system (U, B1, B, B2, V1, V, G) used at Geneva Observatory since 1963, mainly for classification of B to G stars.
short_description: Geneva seven-colour system (U B1 B B2 V1 V G) from the GCPD
facility_description: The General Catalogue of Photometric Data (GCPD, Mermilliod, Hauck & Mermilliod; now hosted at Masaryk University, Brno) compiles stellar photometry in more than 80 photometric systems together with system descriptions and filter transmission curves.
notes: NJM's curves for this instrument were taken from the SVO Filter Profile Service (GCPD group). Band Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables, cited via Wayback Machine captures because svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. Bands without the _ADPS suffix whose SVO ProfileReference is arXiv:1412.1474 are the Mann & von Braun (2015) revisions of the GCPD curves; _ADPS bands are the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems versions (Moro & Munari 2000; Fiorucci & Munari 2003), for which SVO's ProfileReference is the GCPD system page. Licence: GCPD publishes no explicit redistribution licence, only a citation request; classed 'attribution' on that basis. filters/fil13.html returns 404; GCPD's Geneva page lists effective wavelengths and widths but no curve download. SVO Description for B_ADPS names the wrong band ('Geneva B1 filter in GCPD (ADPS)'), so it is omitted. No archived SVO VOTable was available for: B, B1, B1_ADPS, B2, B2_ADPS, G, G_ADPS, U, V, V1, V1_ADPS, V_ADPS, so those bands carry no per-band fields.
